competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strong on Swedish GPs, fund performance and the LP side — AP1–AP7, insurers (Folksam, Alecta, AMF) are heavily profiled; alternatives allocations and commitments tracked.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: AP-fund annual reports and holdings disclosures (ap1–ap7.se), FI company register for AIFM/manager identification, SVCA membership, fund managers' own reports — all directly accessible to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Deep on Swedish PE/VC deals, valuations and cap tables; good service-provider tagging (law firms, advisors).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Bolagsverket filings (via data resellers), MFN/Cision/GlobeNewswire press releases, Nasdaq Stockholm/First North listings and prospectuses, SVCA member data — the underlying registry + wire routes are in our catalog.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Best-in-class Swedish startup/scaleup ecosystem mapping; runs co-branded ecosystem dashboards with Nordic agencies.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Bolagsverket/SCB company data, Vinnova grant open data, startup media (Breakit, Di Digital, ArcticStartup), funds' portfolio pages — all public routes we've cataloged.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow Swedish funding-round coverage, English-language bias, self-reported profiles.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases (MFN/Cision/GlobeNewswire), TechCrunch/Breakit-type media, self-submission — the press-wire layer is directly available to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Local champion for private-company financials and M&A target screening across Europe from its Swedish base; proprietary cleaned financials on essentially every SE company.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Bolagsverket annual reports (årsredovisningar) in bulk, SCB business register, group-structure data from registries — proof that the Bolagsverket high-value-datasets API + digital annual reports are the foundation for SE private-company intelligence.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Nordic market leader in listed-company ownership data (Holdings) and IR tooling; expanded into unlisted ownership in 2021; also operates the MFN newswire.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Euroclear Sweden share registers (obtained per-company, not open bulk), FI PDMR and short-position open data, fund holdings reports, Bolagsverket — FI's CSVs and Bolagsverket are directly open to us; Euroclear registers are not.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Dominant SE credit-information provider; allabolag is the consumer-facing free directory with financials, boards, and credit events.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Bolagsverket, Skatteverket (tax status), Kronofogden (payment remarks), SCB — the registry layer is public; the credit-remark layer partly requires licensed access.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Nordic firmographics, media monitoring (Retriever) and risk data (D&B) on all Swedish companies.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Bolagsverket registers and annual reports, SCB, PoIT gazette announcements — same public backbone we ingest directly.

searchedButAbsent: Searched for but not found or not available: (1) a public bulk/API route for the FI company register — only the search UI plus free-reuse policy exists; the register must be crawled per category (MiCA, AIFM, etc.). (2) Exact Riksbank and FI RSS feed URLs — both document RSS subscription mechanisms but concrete feed URLs could not be extracted via fetch (bot/404 issues); needs one browser session to pin down. (3) A native di.se RSS feed that answers to non-browser clients — di.se blocks fetchers outright and third-party feed proxies have sprung up, suggesting the native feed is unreliable. (4) A public online Swedish court/insolvency case register — does not exist; bankruptcy events must come from PoIT (CAPTCHA-walled) and Bolagsverket status data. (5) Open bulk access to Euroclear Sweden share registers (ownership) — per-company paid extracts only. (6) A separate fund-administrator licensee list — fund administration is not separately licensed in Sweden; the FI register categories are the closest proxy. (7) Open bulk UBO data — Bolagsverket's beneficial-ownership register requires e-ID login, consistent with EU-wide access restrictions (per project law: never assume open UBO). (8) NGM/Spotlight bulk issuer downloads — HTML lists only. (9) An RSS or API for Nyhetsbyrån Direkt — the wire has no public site; its telegrams surface via Placera and brokers.
